description: github.com DOM as served on 2026-11-25, both views of two open pull requests, each opened by the capturing account, so the only person in the page is the scrubbed viewer: mergify-sandbox/browser-extension-fixtures#16 (github_pr_opened*, 2026-11-25) and the cancelled-request pages below (2026-11-26). Both views now mount react-app[app-name=repo]. github_pr_opened is the classic view, reached with ?overview=false by an account that opted into the Overview preview: same #new_comment_field form and mergebox-partial anchor as 2026_07, and Mergify's "Tick the box" comment on the page carries the app avatar, so mergifyDetectableFromPage is true; it is no status report, so statusCommentId is null. github_pr_opened_overview_default is the Overview page as it opens: GitHub renamed its telemetry attribute, so the editor's Comment button carries data-telemetry-action="pull_requests.comments.submit" and no data-dd-action-name at all; a lookup on the old name finds no composer and every merge-box button posts nothing (MRGFY-13408). The timeline is not rendered as the page opens (no [data-testid=timeline-item]), so statusCommentId is null there, as on 2026_07's github_pr_opened_overview_default. pullRequestAuthor is null and authorCommentIds empty on the Overview page: it renders no opening post (#pullrequest-<id>) and no a.author link, so the Mergify Stacks panel reads no comment there, as on 2026_07. github_pr_cancelled_request and its _overview were recorded on 2026-11-26 from mergify-sandbox/browser-extension-cancelled-request#1 (queue_controls_comment: false): the author's acknowledged `@Mergifyio queue`, then a push, so Mergify rewrote its report into the 85-character "To request it again, post a `@mergifyio queue` comment." hint and replied that the request was cancelled. The hint carries no payload and never gets a 👍: an extension reading it as the last command holds the row on "Adding to merge queue…" (queuing) instead of unqueued (MRGFY-13536). On these pages the Overview timeline is rendered, so statusCommentId is the report on both views, headed "🛑 Queue command cancelled" in an h3, not Mergify's cancellation reply below it (MRGFY-13539).
